name: Free USI VET transcript
summary: A free, government-authenticated record of all your nationally recognised training since 2015, from your USI account.
key: It's accessible through your USI account, it's government authenticated and it's free.
who: Anyone with a Unique Student Identifier (USI) who has done nationally recognised training.
how: Log in to your USI account through the Student Portal and select View VET Transcript.

source.label: USI: Students and their VET transcripts

evidence.quote: It's accessible through your USI account, it's government authenticated and it's free.
A USI vocational education training (VET) transcript shows all your completed nationally recognised training since 2015.
